set.body:
Scope
Correct Replay candidate-score scaling without consulting the frozen real outcomes, then evaluate the frozen corrected algorithm on participant- and item-disjoint real controls.

Acceptance criteria
- Replay candidate evidence uses mean log predictive density per normalized duration bin, or an exactly equivalent temperature parameterization, so the unit-centred calibration prior is invariant to grid_size.
- Raw total HMM log likelihood remains available as a diagnostic; public provenance declares the evidence scale and residual temperature.
- Unit and synthetic tests cover grid-resolution score/calibration stability, small-sample fallback, candidate order, posterior normalization, and unchanged rank ordering under positive score rescaling.
- The original synthetic and real court artifacts remain immutable and explicitly labelled as pre-correction evidence.
- Before outcome scoring, a protocol freezes seed, thresholds, cohort construction, folds, candidate pool, model specifications, and a participant- and item-disjoint replication sample.
- The replication runs repeated viewing, blank-screen imagery, order ablation, wrong-item and generic-gaze controls, Transport v2, Replay, registered density, nested MultiMatch, and elastic baselines under identical folds.
- Machine-readable artifacts, manifests, uncertainty, runtime, and a bounded verdict are persisted; no post-result retuning is permitted.
- The epic closes only if its literal real-gate contract is satisfied; otherwise it remains open with the scientifically correct negative result and next blocker recorded.
set.title: GW-9 Make Replay calibration resolution-invariant and run an independent real replication
